source: 639 Bribe
target: 639 Corruptio

source: Lumian stood before the open mechanical elevator door, casting a glance at the slender shadow beside him.
target: Lumian coram porta machinae elevatoriae apertae stetit, et umbram tenuem iuxta se intuitus est.

source: With raised eyebrows, he calmly turned his head, noting the sudden presence diagonally behind him.
target: Supercilia sublata, caput suum tranquille vertit, praesentiam subitaneam obliquē post se notans.

source: The figure appeared as a tall, thin man draped in a complex, layered black robe.
target: Figura apparuit ut vir altus et tenuis, indutus veste nigra multiplex.

source: His face bore a pale‑white complexion, as though untouched by sunlight for an extended period.
target: Vultus eius cutem pallidam ostendebat, quasi diu radii solaris non contrectatus esset.

source: Atop his black hair sat a fluffy black hat, its edge adorned with a gently swaying white feather.
target: Super capillos nigros eius, sedebat pileus niger lanuginosus, cuius ora plumula alba leniter volitans ornata erat.

source: Lumian retracted his gaze and entered the mechanical elevator.
target: Lumian aspectum retraxit et in machinam elevatariam intravit.

source: The tall, thin man with dark brown eyes followed suit in silence.
target: Vir altus et tenuis, oculis fuscis, silentio secutus est.

source: Gripping the brass handle with his right hand, Lumian selected the desired floor, pressing it down to B3 as a definitive “click” echoed in response.
target: Dextro manu manubrium aeneum intus prehensus, Lumian tabulatum desideratum elegerat, illud ad B3 premens, dum sonitus fixus “click” in responsione resonabat.

source: After Lumian selected his intended floor, the lanky man mimicked his action, opting for B18.
target: Postquam Lumian tabulatum suum destinatum elegerat, vir gracilis eius actum imitatus est, optans ad B18.

source: As they awaited descent, the distant sound of steam hissing reached their ears.
target: Dum descensum exspectabant, sonus vaporis sibilans ex longinquo auribus eorum pervenit.

source: Gears whirred to life, chains tightened, and the luxurious mechanical elevator began its gradual descent.
target: Rotae ad vitam excitatae sunt, catenae stringebantur, et luxuriosa machina elevatoria paulatim descendere coepit.

source: Throughout the journey, both remained eerily silent, the atmosphere thick with unspoken tension.
target: Per totum iter, ambo mirabili silentio mansere, cum atmosphaera densa tensionis tacita impleta esset.

source: Upon arrival at B3, Lumian departed without a backward glance, heading toward Suite 7 with purpose.
target: Adventum ad B3 perventum, Lumian sine retrospecto discessit, versus Suite 7 cum proposito properavit.

source: As the metal chains continued their retreat behind him, Lumian muttered thoughtfully to himself, “Monsieur Iveljsta?”
target: Dum catenae ferreae post eum recedebant, Lumian ad se meditatus murmurat, “Monsieur Iveljsta?”

source: Iveljsta, residing in B18, harbored lifeless servants.
target: Iveljsta, in B18 habitans, servos inanimatos habebat.

source: The peculiar appearance of Iveljsta and the condition of his servants led Lumian to suspect his association with a Wraith, a Sequence 5 Wraith of the Prisoner pathway.
target: Species insolita Iveljstae et status servorum eius adduxerunt Lumian suspicari eum coniunctum esse cum Umbrā, Umbrā Sequenciae V ex via Captivi.

source: The Prisoner pathway, controlled by the Rose School of Thought, held sway over temperance and indulgence factions, both intertwined with the secret organization.
target: Via Captivi, a Schola Rosi Cogitationis moderante, imperium habebat super factiones temperantiae et indulgentiae, quae utraque cum organizatione secreta contextae erant.

source: It seemed unlikely for a Wraith not to be affiliated with the Rose School of Thought.
target: Videtur improbabile esse ut Umbra non coniungatur cum Schola Rosi Cogitationis.

source: Could it be a rare rogue Wraith, or perhaps the vanguard of the Rose School of Thought targeting Port Pylos?
target: Num esset rara Umbra vagabunda, aut fortasse praecursio Scholae Rosi Cogitationis ad Portum Pylos destinata?

source: Lumian couldn’t discount the possibility of a temperance faction member.
target: Lumian possibilitatem ut esset membrum factionis temperantiae non potuit neglegere.

source: Yet, in the past few minutes, he discerned no evidence of Iveljsta’s protracted indulgence… Lumian resolved to detail his observations in Madam Magician’s letter.
target: Attamen, in paucis minutis praeteritis, nullum signum indulgentiae diuturnae Iveljstae animadvertit; itaque Lumian statuivit observationes suas in epistola Dominae Magicae enarrari.

source: Whether something was good or bad would be determined by professionals!
target: Utrum aliquid bonum vel malum sit, ab peritis determinabitur!

source: Returning to Suite 7, Lumian noticed Ludwig seated at the dining table, indulging in a feast from a ceramic soup pot with a silver spoon.
target: Revertens ad Suite 7, Lumian animadvertit Ludovicum ad mensam epulandum sedere, convivium ex olla ceramica cum cochlea argentea degustans.

source: Atop the dish, a layer of cheese infused with egg juice charred in spots.
target: Super ferculo, stratum casei, succo ovorum infuso, in quibusdam partibus comburatum, iacebat.

source: Through the sizable hole Ludwig had carved, Lumian glimpsed a medley of pork, beef, fish, shrimp, shells, potatoes, and tomatoes stewed together.
target: Per foramen ingens, quod Ludwig effodierat, Lumian intuebar mixturam porcinae, bubulae, piscis, palaemonis, concharum, tuberorum solanaceorum, et lycopersicorum simul coctorum.

source: The rich aroma of spices mingled with the meats’ essence permeated the living and dining rooms, casting a spell that stirred his appetite.
target: Aroma dives specierum, cum essentia carnium miscenti, per conclavia vitae et cenandi diffuse se effudit, incantationem efficacem afferens quae appetitum eius excitavit.

source: Ludwig continued to eat in silence as Lugano stood up and asked, “Would you like some? This is the local Eseo. Different chefs choose different ingredients, and the taste will vary.”
target: Ludwig silentio edebat, cum Lugano surrexit et quaesivit: “Visne aliquid? Hic est Eseo localis. Diversi coqui diversa ingredientia eligunt, et sapor variabit.”

source: Ludwig, without uttering a word, simply turned his head at Lugano before resuming his meal, quickening his pace.
target: Ludwig, sine verbo ullo, caput ad Lugano vertit, atque cibum suum rursus assumpsit, celeritate augens.

source: Taking a seat beside Ludwig, Lumian smiled at the cheese‑filled boy and said, “I was going to bring you a better supper, but I thought better of it.”
target: Consedens iuxta Ludovicum, Lumian puero caseo pleno subridet et dixit: “Cenam meliorem tibi ferre intendebam, sed melius putavi.”

source: Confused, Lugano inquired, “What supper?”
target: Confusus, Lugano quaesivit: “Quae cena?”

source: “You don’t want to know,” Lumian responded with a Devil‑like smile.
target: “Nescis,” respondit Lumian cum risu diaboli similis.

source: The supper he alluded to was Serial Killer Bram’s corpse.
target: Cena, quam insinuabat, erat corpus Interfectoris Serialis Bram.

source: Originally intending to bring a few pieces back for Ludwig to sample and discern any “nutrients” and information, Lumian reconsidered, aware of Bram’s limited knowledge about the Andariel family’s peculiarities.
target: Primitim intendens paucas partes Ludovicum gustare atque nutrimenta atque informationes detegere, Lumian remedit, conscius scientiae modicae Bram de singularibus Andariel familiae.

source: Thus, he abandoned the idea of feeding Ludwig out of prudence.
target: Itaque, propter prudentiam, consilium Ludovicum alendi deseruit.

source: From Lumian’s observations, Ludwig could derive some strength from eating, releasing the seal.
target: Ex observationibus Lumiani, Ludwig ex edendo aliquam vim consequi poterat, sigillum solvens.

source: However, consuming a Sequence 7 Beyonder corpse might trigger a significant change.
target: Attamen, corpus Beyonder Sequenciae VII edendo, mutationem significantem excitare posset.

source: Lumian feared his own strength might not suffice to manage potential complications; Ludwig could potentially turn the tables and consume him as a delicacy.
target: Lumian timebat ne sua virtus ad tractandas difficultates non sufficeret; Ludwig fortasse remittere posset et eum tamquam delicium edere.

source: Ludwig’s silver spoon paused briefly before he remarked, “If you didn’t bring it, why did you mention it?”
target: Cochlea argentea Ludovigi paulisper cessavit, et tum dixit: “Si id non tulisti, cur id memorasti?”

source: “Oh, having a little tantrum?” Lumian chuckled inwardly and said, “It’s to inform you that we’ve reached an adventurer’s paradise, a land of chaos. You’ll have ample opportunities for fine dining in the future.”
target: “O, parum iratus es?” Lumian interius subridens dixit: “Hic tibi declarandum est: ad paradisum adventurarum pervenimus, terram tumultus. Futuris tibi plures occasiones ad convivium exquisitum erunt.”

source: The implication was clear: do well, and I’ll remember to reward you with delicacies.
target: Implicatio clara erat: age bene, et meminero te deliciis praemiis remuneratum iri.

source: Ludwig, spooning a soft potato stew into his mouth, responded vaguely, “I’m not going to school.”
target: Ludwig, cochleā molli pultis solanaceis in os sumens, vago respondit: “Non ad scholam ibo.”

source: Does this mean that as long as he doesn’t go to school, everything else is negotiable?
target: Num hoc significat quod, dummodo ad scholam non it, omnia cetera negotiabilia sint?

source: Of course, the prerequisite is that I have to pay with enough delicacies… Satisfied, Lumian rose and made his way to the washroom adjoining the master bedroom, where he washed up.
target: Certe, praerequisitum est ut cum deliciis satis solvam… Satis contentus, Lumian surrexit et ad latrinam, quae cubiculo principali adiacens erat, pervenit, ubi se lavavit.

source: The brass faucet delivered warm water at a comfortable temperature.
target: Fistula aenea aquam calidam, ad commodam temperaturam, praebebat.

source: Lumian soaked a towel, relishing the refreshing steam that enveloped his face, invigorating him.
target: Lumian linteum immergit, vaporis refrigerantis, qui faciem eius complectebatur, delectatus, eum revigorans.

source: Hotel Orella’s utilization of a steam engine to power its mechanical elevators and machinery ensured continuous hot water, a notable feature of its service.
target: Hotel Orella machinam vaporariam ad elevatoria mechanica et alia instrumenta movenda adhibens, aquam calidam permanentem praestabat, pars insignis servitii eius.

source: The following morning, Lumian, sporting a golden straw hat, appeared on Cania Street beside Port Pylos’s Resurrection Square.
target: Postero mane, Lumian, pileum stramineum aureum gerens, apparuit in Via Cania iuxta Plateam Resurrectionis Portus Pylos.

source: Once the ruling center for Intis colonists in Matani, the area bore remnants of its history with road signs and shop names in the Intisian language.
target: Olim centrum regendi colonorum Intis in Matani, regio reliquias historiae suae portabat, cum signis viariis et nominibus tabernarum in lingua Intisiana.

source: Lumian effortlessly traced the path beneath the Intis parasol trees, arriving at a four‑story beige house showcasing Intis’s opulent architectural style.
target: Lumian facile iter sub arboribus parasolorum Intis secutus est, ad domum quattuor stratorum coloris beige perveniens, quae opulentum stilum architectonicum Intis exhibebat.

source: Signs adorned in Dutanese, Intisian, Highlander, Loen, and Feysac languages marked the building: “Port Pylos Patrol Team.”
target: Signa, in linguis Dutanica, Intisiana, Highlander, Loen, et Feysac inscripta, aedificium indicabant: “Portus Pylos Turma Vigiliarum.”

source: Below the sign, five lines had the same meaning: “Only deals with paranormal events.”
target: Sub signo, quinque lineae idem significabant: “Solum de rebus paranormalibus agitur.”

source: Fully taking into account the needs of adventurers from different countries to report a case… Lumian playfully remarked as he entered the beige establishment.
target: Plene intellegens necessitatem adventurarum ex diversis terris ad casus referendos, Lumian iocosus dixit, dum in aedificium beige intrabat.

source: Within the hall, devoid of occupants, Lumian found a receptionist casually perusing the day’s local tabloid from a lounging position.
target: In atrio, absens hominum, Lumian reperit receptorem qui ex sede quieta diurnum tabloidum localem perlegebat.

source: The native, in his thirties with dark brown skin and black hair, possessed a slender face and dark brown eyes.
target: Indigenus, in annis tricesimalibus versans, cum cute fusca et capillis nigris, faciem tenuem atque oculos fuscos habebat.

source: Approaching, Lumian addressed him in Intisian, “I want to report a case.”
target: Accedens, Lumian eum in lingua Intisiana alloquens dixit: “Casum referre volo.”

source: The native glanced up, rising unsteadily.
target: Indigenus sursum intuitus instabiliter surrexit.

source: He opened a partition behind him, uttering a few incomprehensible words in Dutanese.
target: Post se partitionem aperuit, paucas verba in Dutanica, inaudita, pronuntians.

source: Lumian could barely understand him speaking in Dutanese.
target: Lumian vix intellexit eum in Dutanica loquens.

source: “Someone who understands Intisian or Highlander…”
target: “Aliquis qui linguam Intisianam aut Highlander intellegat…”

source: This won’t do. Since you don’t understand foreign languages, don’t waste time reading the newspaper. Study diligently… Maintaining a genial smile, he patiently awaited other patrol team members to appear.
target: Hoc non sufficit. Quia linguas externas non intellegis, tempus ne perdas legendi diurnum. Studio diligenter exerce, et supercilio benigno servato, ceteros membros turmae vigiliarum patienter exspectabat.

source: Within a mere minute or two, a young man with fluffy brown hair, who appeared as if he had fallen asleep without washing his hair the night before, swung open the door from the depths of the hall.
target: In uno vel duobus minutis, iuvenis cum capillis fusco lanuginosis, qui videbatur quasi nocte praeterita sine capillos lavandis obdormatus, ostium e profundis atrii sub alacri impetu aperuit.

source: Dressed in a white shirt and an unbuttoned yellow vest, he strolled toward Lumian, one hand casually tucked into his pocket.
target: Indutus camisia alba et vestem flavam solutam, ambulavit versus Lumian, una manu leviter in sinu posita.

source: In fluent Intisian, he inquired, “What case are you filing?”
target: In lingua Intisiana fluente, interrogavit: “Quod casum referis?”

source: Lumian assessed the young man, unmistakably hailing from the Northern Continent, cigarette in hand, and eyes of a brownish‑yellow hue.
target: Lumian iuvenem aestimavit, indubitanter ex Continente Septentrionali oriundum, habentem cigarette in manu et oculos fuscos–flavos.

source: With a reserved smile, Lumian responded, “I found a killer.”
target: Cum risu constituto, Lumian respondit: “Interfector inveni.”

source: Amused, the well‑defined young man gestured toward the door.
target: Iuvenis, risu oblectatus, digitum ad ostium movit.

source: “For killers, go to the police on the opposite street.”
target: “Interfectores, ite ad vigiles in via opposita.”

source: Opposite the patrol team stood Port Pylos’s police headquarters.
target: In via opposita stabat praesidium vigilum Portus Pylos.

source: Maintaining his composure, Lumian reiterated, “He’s a serial killer.”
target: Servans se compositum, Lumian iteravit: “Interfector serialis est.”

source: “Serial killer…” The young man with the cigarette muttered to himself, his shifting demeanor betraying a sudden seriousness.
target: “Interfector serialis…” Iuvenis, cigarette habens, ad se murmurat, mutatio in vultu eius subitam gravitatem indicans.

source: “How do you know?”
target: “Quomodo scis?”

source: “I found many severed lips in his house—human lips,” Lumian disclosed with a reserved smile.
target: “Multa labia abscissa in domo eius inveni—labia humana,” Lumian, risu constituto, declaravit.

source: “Cut‑off lips?” The young man, yet to fasten his yellow vest, pressed with urgency, “Where’s his home?”
target: “Labia abscissa?” Iuvenis, qui vestem flavam suam nondum alligaverat, cum sollicitudine quaesivit: “Ubi est domus eius?”

source: After a brief pause, Lumian replied, “I can’t spell the street name, but I can take you to the scene. It’s on a street near the Man‑Eating Flower bar.”
target: Post brevem intervallum, Lumian respondit: “Nomine viae scribere non possum, sed te ad locum ducere possum. Ea in via prope tabernam ‘Floris Voracis’ sita est.”

source: Forcing himself to calm down, the young man took a drag on his cigarette and asked, “What about the killer? Did you see his face?”
target: Coacto se ad quietem, iuvenis cigarette trahens rogavit: “Quid de interfectore? Num faciem eius vidisti?”

source: “He’s dead,” Lumian truthfully responded.
target: “Mortuus est,” respondit Lumian sincere.

source: Taken aback for a moment, the brown‑haired young man queried, “How did he die?”
target: Subito obstupefactus, iuvenis capillis fusco ornatus interrogavit: “Quomodo mortuus est?”

source: Lumian’s reserved smile transformed into a more open one.
target: Risu moderato Lumiani, constitutus, in risum apertiorem mutatus est.

source: “I killed him.”
target: “Eum interfeci.”

source: The young man’s expression froze in disbelief.
target: Vultus iuvenis in stupefactu congelatus est.

source: He scrutinized Lumian for a few seconds before inquiring, “Are you an adventurer here to collect the bounty?”
target: Eum Lumian per paucos secundos perspexit, deinde quaesivit: “Esne adventor hic, ut praemium raccipias?”

source: Bram’s serial murders had prompted a local wanted poster issued by Admiral Querarill.
target: Caedes seriales Bram excitaverunt, quae duxerunt ad posterum localem deprehensionis a Admirali Querarill editum.

source: However, the poster lacked a corresponding name or appearance, featuring only a case description due to the suspect’s unidentified status.
target: Attamen, tabula nomen aut speciem respondentem non habebat, sed solam descriptionem casus exhibebat, propter statum suspecti incognitum.

source: Smiling, Lumian replied, “Sort of, but you can also claim it.”
target: Subridente, Lumian respondit: “Quasi, sed id etiam vindicare potes.”

source: The young man cast a glance at Lumian.
target: Iuvenis oculos in Lumian coniecit.

source: “What would you like in exchange?”
target: “Quid in commutatione desideras?”

source: “I want the dossier on a serial murder case from four years ago and the relevant items you gathered,” Lumian disclosed openly.
target: “Volo dossier de casu caedis serialis ex annis quattuor abhinc, atque res pertinentes quas congregavisti,” Lumian aperte declaravit.

source: There might be something among them that Ludwig could consume.
target: Inter ea fortasse aliquid est quod Ludovicus edere possit.

source: The young man fell into contemplative silence, assessing the pros and cons.
target: Iuvenis in silentio contemplativo cecidit, pros et contraria aestimans.

source: Eventually, he scratched his brown hair and said, “I can show you the case dossier and related items, but you can’t take them away. You can only copy them.
target: Postremo, capillos fuscos excoriavit et dixit: “Tibi dossier casus et res pertinentes ostendere possum, sed ea tibi detrahere non licet. Solum ea exscribere potes.

source: Also, I need to confirm if it’s a Serial Killer at the scene.”
target: Item, mihi confirmare opus est utrum in loco interfector serialis adsit.”

source: “Alright,” Lumian agreed, extending his right hand with a smile. “Happy working with you.”
target: “Bene,” inquit Lumian, dextro manu extendens cum risu, “Gaudeo operari tecum.”

source: The young man shook Lumian’s hand.
target: Iuvenis manum Lumiani concussit.

source: “Nice working with you. You can call me Camus. What about you?”
target: “Iucundum operari tecum. Me Camus vocare potes. Quid de te?”

source: Lumian smiled once more.
target: Lumian iterum subridens restitit.

source: “Louis Berry.”
target: “Louis Berry.”

source: As Camus entered the door deep in the hall, preparing to gather two teammates, he pondered, “Louis Berry… Why does this name sound familiar…”
target: Cum Camus ostium in profundo atrii intravit, duo sodales congregare parans, meditatus est: “Louis Berry… Cur hoc nomen mihi familiariter sonat?”
